Title: Log in with valid credentials
Preconditions: A registered user exists (auto-provisioned via API by the framework)
Test Data: username / password of the registered user
Steps:
1. Open https://www.demoblaze.com
2. Click 'Log in' in the navbar
3. Enter valid username and password
4. Click 'Log in'
Expected Result: Modal closes, page reloads; navbar shows 'Welcome <username>' and 'Log out'; 'Log in' and 'Sign up' are hidden.

Title: Wrong password is rejected
Preconditions: A registered user exists (auto-provisioned via API by the framework)
Steps:
1. Open Log in modal
2. Enter valid username and an incorrect password
3. Click 'Log in'
Expected Result: Alert 'Wrong password.' is shown; user stays logged out.

Title: Unregistered username is rejected
Steps:
1. Open Log in modal
2. Enter an unregistered username and any password
3. Click 'Log in'
Expected Result: Alert 'User does not exist.' is shown; user stays logged out.

Title: Both fields empty
Steps:
1. Open Log in modal
2. Leave both fields empty
3. Click 'Log in'
Expected Result: Alert 'Please fill out Username and Password.'; no login request succeeds.

Title: Username empty
Steps:
1. Open Log in modal
2. Fill only the password
3. Click 'Log in'
Expected Result: Alert 'Please fill out Username and Password.'

Title: Password empty
Steps:
1. Open Log in modal
2. Fill only the username
3. Click 'Log in'
Expected Result: Alert 'Please fill out Username and Password.'

Title: Password input is masked
Steps:
1. Open Log in modal
2. Type into the Password field
Expected Result: Password field is type='password'; characters are masked.

Title: Session survives a page reload
Preconditions: A registered user exists (auto-provisioned via API by the framework)
Steps:
1. Log in with valid credentials
2. Reload the page (F5)
Expected Result: User remains logged in ('Welcome <username>' still shown).

Title: User can log out
Steps:
1. Log in
2. Click 'Log out'
Expected Result: User is redirected to home; 'Log in' / 'Sign up' visible, 'Welcome' and 'Log out' hidden.

Title: Closing the modal does not log the user in
Preconditions: A registered user exists (auto-provisioned via API by the framework)
Steps:
1. Open Log in modal
2. Fill valid credentials
3. Click 'Close' instead of 'Log in'
Expected Result: Modal closes; user is still logged out.

Title: A newly signed-up user can log in
Steps:
1. Click 'Sign up'
2. Register a new unique user
3. Accept 'Sign up successful.'
4. Log in with the new credentials
Expected Result: Sign-up alert 'Sign up successful.'; login succeeds with 'Welcome <username>'.

Title: Duplicate username is rejected on sign up
Preconditions: A registered user exists (auto-provisioned via API by the framework)
Steps:
1. Click 'Sign up'
2. Enter an already registered username
3. Click 'Sign up'
Expected Result: Alert 'This user already exist.'

Title: Close login modal with the × icon / Esc
Steps:
1. Open Log in modal
2. Click the × icon
3. Re-open and press Esc
Expected Result: Modal closes each time; page remains usable.

Title: Username with leading/trailing spaces
Preconditions: A registered user exists (auto-provisioned via API by the framework)
Steps:
1. Open Log in modal
2. Enter the valid username padded with spaces + valid password
3. Click 'Log in'
Expected Result: Behaviour is consistent and defined (either trimmed and accepted, or clearly rejected) — no confusing error.

Title: Username case sensitivity
Preconditions: A registered user exists (auto-provisioned via API by the framework)
Steps:
1. Open Log in modal
2. Enter the username with changed letter case + valid password
3. Click 'Log in'
Expected Result: Matches product rule for usernames (case-sensitive → 'User does not exist.'). Document actual behaviour.

Title: Very long username / password (500+ chars)
Steps:
1. Open Log in modal
2. Paste 500+ characters into both fields
3. Click 'Log in'
Expected Result: Handled gracefully: an error alert, no hang, no layout break.

Title: Unicode credentials
Preconditions: User registered with unicode username e.g. 'người_dùng'
Steps:
1. Sign up with a unicode username
2. Log in with it
Expected Result: Login succeeds; welcome text renders unicode correctly.

Title: Double-click on 'Log in'
Preconditions: A registered user exists (auto-provisioned via API by the framework)
Steps:
1. Open Log in modal
2. Fill credentials
3. Double-click 'Log in' quickly
Expected Result: Single successful login; no duplicate errors.

Title: Login state shared between tabs
Preconditions: A registered user exists (auto-provisioned via API by the framework)
Steps:
1. Log in in tab A
2. Open the site in tab B
Expected Result: Tab B shows the user as logged in (cookie-based session).

Title: Expired / tampered token
Test Data: edit 'tokenp_' cookie to a random value
Steps:
1. Log in
2. Change the 'tokenp_' cookie value in DevTools
3. Reload the page
Expected Result: User treated as logged out or alert 'Bad parameter, token malformed.' / 'Your token has expired, please login again.'
